propositions: Quickstart examples in README.md and user-guide.md incorrectly teach bare handle values for --assignee (e.g. 'alice') that are not Jira-resolvable, contradicting docs/config.md which requires Jira-resolvable identities.
Documentation describes flat .rebar/config.conf as the primary config surface, but rebar.toml and [tool.rebar] are the current active formats; .rebar/config.conf is removed.
MCP navigation link in docs/README.md routes to llm-framework.md instead of the authoritative docs/mcp-reference.md.
pyproject.toml comment claims mypy checks are advisory-only, but CI gates mypy over the whole library and scripts/ directory.
A library code example (README.md) uses rebar.claim(tid, assignee='alice') with a bare handle instead of omitting the parameter to use the configured default.
